title: MoQ Relay
description: MoQ relay 0.17.10 operational and traffic counters. Traffic/control series can be absent before first use; no data is not zero. Rates use a minimum 1-minute scrape interval and need at least two samples.

panels.title: Scrape health
panels.description: Latest Prometheus scrape status per selected instance. No data means the target series is absent, not healthy.

panels.title: Active sessions
panels.description: Connected sessions, summed across tiers. Opened/started minus closed/ended since process start. Series may be absent until traffic creates them.

panels.title: Active viewers
panels.description: Distinct (broadcast, session) subscriptions, summed across tiers and roles; not necessarily unique people. Opened/started minus closed/ended since process start. Series may be absent until traffic creates them.

panels.title: Active subscriptions
panels.description: Track subscriptions, summed across tiers and roles. Opened/started minus closed/ended since process start. Series may be absent until traffic creates them.

panels.title: Active announces
panels.description: Broadcast announces, summed across tiers and roles. Opened/started minus closed/ended since process start. Series may be absent until traffic creates them.

panels.title: Scrape availability over time
panels.description: Per-instance scrape status: 1 = up, 0 = down. Gaps mean no scrape series.

panels.title: Draining sessions
panels.description: Sessions sent shutdown GOAWAY that have not yet left. Zero alone does not establish whether a drain is underway; a shutdown may exit between scrapes.

panels.title: Sessions by tier
panels.description: Cumulative starts/opens minus ends/closes, per process. Empty tier is the default tier; traffic series may be absent until first use.

panels.title: Viewers by tier and role
panels.description: Cumulative starts/opens minus ends/closes, per process. Empty tier is the default tier; traffic series may be absent until first use.

panels.title: Subscriptions by tier and role
panels.description: Cumulative starts/opens minus ends/closes, per process. Empty tier is the default tier; traffic series may be absent until first use.

panels.title: Announces by tier and role
panels.description: Cumulative starts/opens minus ends/closes, per process. Empty tier is the default tier; traffic series may be absent until first use.

panels.title: Media payload bytes
panels.description: Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier. Payload only; excludes transport overhead.

panels.title: Frames
panels.description: Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier. Transferred media frames per second.

panels.title: Groups
panels.description: Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier. Transferred media groups per second; datagrams are a subset of groups.

panels.title: Datagrams
panels.description: Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier. Single-frame groups carried over unreliable QUIC datagrams; already included in groups.

panels.title: Skipped payload bytes
panels.description: Skipped after media drifted beyond a subscriber latency budget. Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier. Counters measure skipped media, not measured latency.

panels.title: Skipped frames
panels.description: Skipped after media drifted beyond a subscriber latency budget. Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier. Counters measure skipped media, not measured latency.

panels.title: Skipped groups
panels.description: Skipped after media drifted beyond a subscriber latency budget. Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier. Counters measure skipped media, not measured latency.

panels.title: Skipped datagrams
panels.description: Skipped after media drifted beyond a subscriber latency budget. Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier. Counters measure skipped media, not measured latency.

panels.title: Control traffic by class
panels.description: Control bytes encoded for sending or decoded on receipt, including codec prefixes but excluding transport overhead. Empty tier is the default tier.

panels.title: One-shot fetches
panels.description: One-shot group fetches requested per second, by relay role and tier. Role is the relay accounting side: subscriber = ingress/writes, publisher = egress/reads, not the session SETUP role. Empty tier is the default tier.

panels.title: Session churn
panels.description: Starts/opens and ends/closes per second, per instance. Rates are calculated before aggregation to handle counter resets.

panels.title: Viewer churn
panels.description: Starts/opens and ends/closes per second, per instance. Rates are calculated before aggregation to handle counter resets.

panels.title: Subscription churn
panels.description: Starts/opens and ends/closes per second, per instance. Rates are calculated before aggregation to handle counter resets.

panels.title: Announce churn
panels.description: Starts/opens and ends/closes per second, per instance. Rates are calculated before aggregation to handle counter resets.

panels.title: Accept failures by listener and class
panels.description: Failed TCP accept() calls per second. Exhausted indicates resource exhaustion; connection is often junk traffic, unknown is an unclassified errno. An outage can also prevent scraping, so inspect scrape health.

panels.title: Accept stall duration
panels.description: Time a listener has been unable to accept a connection; zero while serving. A prolonged resource failure may prevent the exporter from being scraped.
